card: Re-cut a candidate by whole lines: `clips recut` re-gates a sibling cut
guard_cases: the parent X is byte-identical after the recut (asserted inside case 1, not a separate case)
deviations_from_card: (1) window::cut_lines takes the payoff index too (cut_lines(stream, first, last, payoff, band)): min_first needs it; payoff is recomputed from the anchor beat and its marker exactly as the scan does. (2) Case 3 opens past the setup by the computed number of lines (open=+k, k = setup - first + 1) rather than literally +1, since a scan's cut opens >=12 s before the payoff so +1 never reaches the setup; it also asserts k-1 still lands. (3) The CLI case writes a 60-line SEG-01 run under <tmp>/runs/sim/fixture-t/recut-run instead of the checked-in fixture-run, which holds only two say lines (too short to move an edge). (4) Case 2's message reads 'the window would run 36.7 s, over the 35 s band' (prefixed 'recut of <id>: '). (5) lib.rs untouched (no re-export needed). 'Red before' = the API/verb did not exist (tests could not compile); retention case additionally shown red by removing the is_recut retention line. Tests and implementation committed together in each commit (they cannot compile apart).
notes: Lines are addressed as transcript line_nos: a viewer's question shares its answer's line_no and travels with it. A recut whose lines another candidate already holds is a Conflict; open=close=0 is Invalid. Hook and audio are carried from the parent with a provenance note ('not re-measured on this cut'); chat/marker recomputed. Rescan retention: first history entry by="recut" (scan::RECUT_BY / scan::is_recut), counted in report.kept. The daemon resolves the run from the candidate's transcript label under the runs root, else runs::find_run under <runs>/sim/; a candidate scanned from a dir outside the runs root gets NotFound with that reason. No RPC/contract/types change.
